display.purpose: Hero headline only. One per page. 8-10 words max.

headline.purpose: Section titles. First thing scanned. One message per section.

body.purpose: Standard body copy. Max 65-75ch line length.

shadows.name: ambient
shadows.purpose: Subtle separation for small floating elements.

shadows.name: signal-glow
shadows.purpose: Hover state on dark cards. Communicates interactivity.

shadows.name: active-glow
shadows.purpose: Active or featured elements. Brightest state.

motion.name: entrance
motion.purpose: Panel entrances, chip appearances, fill expansions. Exponential ease-out.

motion.name: micro
motion.purpose: Hover state changes, border color transitions.

motion.name: cta-beam
motion.purpose: AnimatedCTA SVG border beam. Fastest animation in the system.

components.name: Button Primary
components.description: The only call-to-action that glows. Used once per section as the primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0065fe 0%, #15b7fe 100%); color: #ebebed; font-family: 'Poppins', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 16px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 200ms ease, box-shadow 200ms ease, transform 150ms ease; text-decoration: none; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(0,101,254,0.4); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #15b7fe; outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 16px; }

components.name: Button Secondary
components.description: Alternative path. Never competes with primary. On dark backgrounds only.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: transparent; color: #ebebed; font-family: 'Poppins', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(21,183,254,0.4); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 200ms ease, background-color 200ms ease, transform 150ms ease; text-decoration: none; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #15b7fe; background: rgba(21,183,254,0.08); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #15b7fe; outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 16px; }

components.name: Badge Brand
components.description: Section eyebrow on dark backgrounds. Always uppercase, always pill-shaped.
components.css: .ds-badge-brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(0,101,254,0.15); color: #15b7fe; border: 1px solid rgba(21,183,254,0.3); font-family: 'Poppins', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.07em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Card Dark
components.description: Standard content card on dark section backgrounds.
components.html:
Governança de agentes

Logs, auditorias e visibilidade em tempo real para operações que não podem errar.
components.css: .ds-card-dark { background: #12103d; border: 1px solid rgba(21,183,254,0.12); border-radius: 24px; padding: 24px; transition: border-color 200ms ease, box-shadow 200ms ease; } .ds-card-dark:hover { border-color: rgba(21,183,254,0.35); box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(21,183,254,0.15); } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Poppins', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 600; color: #ebebed; margin-bottom: 8px; line-height: 1.3; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-card-body { font-family: 'Poppins', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(235,235,237,0.55); line-height: 1.6; }

components.name: Animated CTA
components.description: Signature pill CTA with animated SVG border beam and directional arrow swap. Three variants: light (dark bg), dark (light bg), gradient (Abismo bg).
components.html: Ver a plataforma em ação
components.css: .ds-animated-cta { position: relative; display: inline-flex; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 4px; border: 1px solid rgba(21,183,254,0.22); } .ds-animated-cta-svg { pointer-events: none; position: absolute; inset: 0; height: 100%; width: 100%; } @keyframes ds-cta-beam { from { stroke-dashoffset: 150; } to { stroke-dashoffset: -350; } } .ds-cta-border { stroke-dasharray: 150 350; stroke-dashoffset: 150; animation: ds-cta-beam 1.5s linear infinite; } .ds-animated-cta-inner { position: relative; z-index: 1; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 40px auto 40px; align-items: center; border-radius: 9999px; overflow: hidden; height: 44px; padding: 0 8px; background: #0c0a3b; text-decoration: none; } .ds-cta-arrow { width: 40px; height: 40px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 9999px; flex-shrink: 0; background: rgba(21,183,254,0.14); border: 1px solid rgba(21,183,254,0.28); color: #ebebed; transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), opacity 0.3s ease; } .ds-cta-arrow-left { transform: scale(0); opacity: 0; } .ds-cta-label { text-align: center; font-family: 'Poppins', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; white-space: nowrap; padding: 0 12px; color: #ebebed; } [data-animated-cta]:hover .ds-cta-arrow-left { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; } [data-animated-cta]:hover .ds-cta-arrow-right { transform: scale(0); opacity: 0; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-cta-border { animation: none; } .ds-cta-arrow { transition: none; } }

components.name: Header Pill (Scrolled)
components.description: The floating navigation pill that appears after 40px of scroll. Glassmorphism used purposefully — the one sanctioned exception.
components.css: .ds-header-pill { position: fixed; top: 16px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); z-index: 50; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; max-width: 1180px; width: calc(100% - 32px); padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(12,10,59,0.82); backdrop-filter: blur(20px); border: 1px solid rgba(21,183,254,0.12); box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.4); } .ds-header-logo { font-family: 'Poppins', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1rem; color: #ebebed; } .ds-header-login { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 6px 16px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid rgba(21,183,254,0.35); color: #ebebed; font-family: 'Poppins', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 200ms ease, background-color 200ms ease; } .ds-header-login:hover { border-color: #15b7fe; background: rgba(21,183,254,0.08); } .ds-header-login:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #15b7fe; outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 9999px; }

narrative.overview:
The InBot design system is built for operators, not spectators. Every surface, every interaction, and every typographic choice is an instrument: legible under pressure, precise by default, and purposeful in what it reveals. The visual language communicates infrastructure — not as a metaphor, but as a material fact. There are no decorative elements that don't earn their place.

The palette lives deep in the spectrum: near-black indigo foundations with electric signal accents that communicate activity, not decoration. The typography is authoritative, with tight tracking on display sizes that reads like a system dashboard, not a marketing page. Motion exists to confirm state changes and guide attention, never to entertain.

What this system explicitly rejects: generic SaaS cream-and-teal templates, chatbot UI with balloon animations and mascots, stock-photo hero sections with smiling professionals, hero-metric layouts with big numbers on gradient backgrounds, and the performative complexity of glassmorphism used as visual filler.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-primary: the default reading environment is deep navy, not white
Instrument precision: every interactive element behaves predictably and confirms its state
Controlled accent: Operator Blue and Live Signal appear purposefully, not as decoration
Tonal depth: surfaces layer from dark to lighter, creating hierarchy without shadow overhead
Motion discipline: animations exist only in orbital diagrams, SVG beams, and entrance reveals

rules.name: The Gradient Rule
rules.body: The primary gradient (Operator Blue → Live Signal, 135°) is reserved for primary CTA elements and the hero background. Never on text except MetricCard values.

rules.name: The Signal Economy Rule
rules.body: Live Signal (#15b7fe) appears in ≤ 3 roles per screen. When it appears everywhere, it loses its signal value. Rarity is the point.

rules.name: The One Sentence Rule
rules.body: If a headline runs to three lines, rewrite it. If a body paragraph runs past 65ch, wrap it. Typography is infrastructure: it routes attention, not prose.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Glows appear only as a response to hover, active state, or diagram animation. A card that glows at rest has no hover state to reveal.

dos: Do use void-midnight (#0c0a3b) as the default dark surface. Never pure black.
Do alternate dark and light sections to create scroll rhythm.
Do use Live Signal (#15b7fe) sparingly: active borders, focus rings, hover glows.
Do keep display headlines at 8-10 words maximum.
Do use tonal layering before reaching for shadows.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion on every animation.
Do give all focusable elements a 2px Live Signal outline with 3px offset.
Do lead with the consequence, not the feature.
Do use the gradient on primary buttons only — one gradient anchor per screen.
donts: Don't use chatbot UI clichés: animated speech bubbles, smiling robot mascots.
Don't use generic SaaS landing templates: cream backgrounds, hero-metric layouts.
Don't use side-stripe borders (border-left > 1px as a colored accent). Prohibited.
Don't use gradient text on body copy, headlines, or labels.
Don't use glassmorphism decoratively — only the floating header pill is sanctioned.
Don't use identical card grids: same icon-plus-title-plus-text repeated uniformly.
Don't use bank-photo aesthetics: smiling people at laptops, stock office imagery.
Don't use buzzwords without evidence: revolutionary, disruptive, transformational.
Don't animate layout properties (width, height, margin, padding).
Don't use bounce or elastic easing. Exponential ease-out only.
Don't open modals as the first response to a user action.
